metadata.mechanics: Spend 20 minutes to perform a ritual to bond two to five Inducted members of the Nuclear Family together. Once during the event they may each call "Upsurge: Heal 10 body and prevent the first instance of gaining a Fracture" while within arms reach of their bonded partner(s). You may only have one bond at a time.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Profession Saint. Must be Inducted to Nuclear Family
metadata.validTargetDescription: 2 to 5 Targets Inducted into the Nuclear Family
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: The Nuclear Home is a term that means something much different in the post-apocalypse than it did before the Fall of humanity. The Nuclear Home is a place where individuals can come together, bond with each other and their neighborhood of faithful, and become a dedication of faith and devotion to each other. The Promise of a Nuclear home is the Benediction of willingly binding oneself to others, as members of the same unit. Traditionally this Benediction includes acts such as the tying of knots, weaving of fabric, blending of colored sands, or other gestures tthat focus on taking the individuals and binding them together. Once a bond has been forged between 2 to 5 people, no members of that group may be bonded to others without breaking their old bond. If a Bond is broken by this way, all remaining members are aware of the break.
